compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: The LORD says, “The people who survive the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.”
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Survivors are said to find favor as Israel seeks rest.
observations.label: Survivors seek rest

observations.body: The wilderness is the place where a surviving people finds favor on the way to rest.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Jeremiah 31:1–4 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The promise names restoration while the route from survival to rest remains compressed.
payload.title: Grace in the wilderness
